packs.name: Code review kit
packs.author: RdotA
packs.description: Reviews, security checks, tests and error explanations for everyday coding.

prompts.title: Review a change
prompts.text:
Review this change like a careful senior engineer. List real problems first (bugs, edge cases, missing error handling), then smaller suggestions. For each, give the line or function and a concrete fix:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Security check
prompts.text: Check this code for security problems: injection, unsafe input handling, secrets, authentication and permission gaps, and unsafe defaults. Rank findings by severity and show how to fix each:

prompts.title: Explain this error
prompts.text:
Explain what this error means, the most likely causes in order, and how to confirm and fix each one:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Suggest tests
prompts.text: List the test cases this code needs (happy path, edge cases, failure modes), then write the most important ones using the project's test framework:

prompts.title: Make it faster
prompts.text: Find the slowest parts of this code and suggest improvements. Estimate the impact of each and keep behaviour identical:

packs.name: Everyday helper
packs.author: RdotA
packs.description: Plan your day, decide faster and turn notes into actions.

prompts.title: Plan my day
prompts.text: Help me plan today ({day}). Here's what I need to do: {ask:Your to-do list}. Order it sensibly, estimate times, and add short breaks.

prompts.title: Summarise this
prompts.text:
Summarise this in five bullet points and one sentence on why it matters:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Help me decide
prompts.text: Help me decide between {ask:Options}. Ask me up to three questions first if you need to, then give a recommendation with the trade-offs.

prompts.title: Draft a reply
prompts.text:
Draft a polite, clear reply to this message. Keep it short:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Meeting notes to actions
prompts.text:
Turn these meeting notes into a list of decisions and action items, each with an owner and a due date if mentioned:

{clipboard}

packs.name: Learn anything
packs.author: RdotA
packs.description: Explanations, quizzes and study plans for any topic.

prompts.title: Explain simply
prompts.text: Explain {ask:Topic} as if I'm new to it: start with the big idea, then the key parts, then one everyday example.

prompts.title: Quiz me
prompts.text: Quiz me on {ask:Topic}. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, tell me if I'm right and why, then ask the next. Start easy and get harder.

prompts.title: Study plan
prompts.text: Make a {ask:How many weeks}-week study plan for learning {ask:Topic}, with goals, resources and a small project for each week.

prompts.title: Compare two things
prompts.text: Compare {ask:First thing} and {ask:Second thing}: what each is for, how they differ, and when to choose which. Finish with a short table.

prompts.title: Analogy please
prompts.text: Give me three different analogies that explain {ask:Concept}, and say where each one breaks down.

packs.name: Writing studio
packs.author: RdotA
packs.description: Tighten, re-tone and proofread anything you write.

prompts.title: Tighten this
prompts.text:
Make this clearer and shorter without losing meaning or my voice. Show the new version, then list the main cuts:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Change the tone
prompts.text:
Rewrite this in a {ask:Tone} tone, keeping every fact the same:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Notes to email
prompts.text:
Turn these notes into a friendly, well-organised email to {ask:Who is it for}. Keep it brief and end with a clear next step:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Headline ideas
prompts.text: Give me ten headline or title ideas for this, from straightforward to playful:

prompts.title: Proofread
prompts.text:
Proofread this. Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation only, and list each change you made:

{clipboard}
